reference_predicate_review.A1: No recent distinct/novel minimum count conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.A2: No recent service count>=8 and concentration/change conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.A3: No recent unique-wallet minimum combined with intensity.
reference_predicate_review.N1/N2: Do not combine breadth, event count, value, current role and rate.
reference_predicate_review.N3: Topology and first-edge ratio separate; no adjacent-amount filtering or any-qualifying-path result.
reference_predicate_review.N4: Share/age do not impose minimum funding, remaining-balance gate or full role conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.S1: Does not expose largest-fragment share or full count/value/rate conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.S2: Does not expose cluster sum or matching-baseline count conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.S3: Does not expose complete-day preceding-median conjunction.
reference_predicate_review.S4: Does not expose current-band gate + in-band distinctness + count/rate conjunction.
